parameters.content:
## Sheet to Notion Sync

Every 15 min -> read sheet rows -> detect changed rows -> dedupe -> create Notion page.

**Duplicate protection**: the key is row_number + updated_at. Editing a row produces a new key (a fresh Notion page); re-running the schedule on unchanged data produces the same key and is skipped.

**Conflict rule**: the sheet is the source of truth. Notion is write-only here - edits made in Notion are NOT pushed back to the sheet, so they can never be silently overwritten.

**Failure behaviour**: Notion calls retry 3 times, then log to workflow_errors. The next run picks the row up again (same key, so no duplicate page once the first attempt succeeded).

**Before activating**: set a Google Sheets credential, a Postgres credential, and your Notion token + database id.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processed_keys (key, workflow, payload, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, 'claimed')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'claimed',
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE processed_keys.status <> 'done'
    AND processed_keys.updated_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
RETURNING key, payload

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: 'YOUR_NOTION_DATABASE_ID' }, properties: { Name: { title: [ { text: { content: $json.name } } ] }, Email: { email: $json.email }, Status: { select: { name: $json.status } }, Updated: { rich_text: [ { text: { content: $json.updatedAt } } ] } } }) }}

INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow, node, message, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)

UPDATE processed_keys
SET status = 'done',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE key = $1
RETURNING key
